acceptanceCriteria: A test shows the member's changedSeq after PREPARING then ALLOCATED, and either changedSeq advances on ALLOCATED or the spec states why it must not.
pool status reports the allocated-at sequence correctly in the allocated case.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0892 lane (pool status, GitHub #647), 2026-10-06: transaction/pools.go poolPosts leaves a member's changedSeq at the PREPARING transition when it becomes ALLOCATED, so pool status cannot report a reliable allocated-at sequence. Suspected defect; not yet reproduced by a failing test.
title: corvint-tasks pools: changedSeq is not updated when a member goes from PREPARING to ALLOCATED
